scripts.game:sync: cp src/game/logic.js ../docs/game/logic.js && cp src/game/quarry.js ../docs/game/quarry.js && npm run audio
scripts.test: npm run core:build && npm run game:sync && node --import ./test/wasm-loader-register.mjs --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.deploy:prepare: sh -c 'command -v cargo >/dev/null || (curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable && . "$HOME/.cargo/env"); PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown; PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npm run core:build && npm run game:sync'
